The existing test permits output until its 1.5-second bound and does not require zero output immediately after deletion. No target code or test was run. The overview's “immediately ends” wording conflicts with the detailed document's one-second active recheck and 15-second idle heartbeat behavior, so source does not settle whether this is a contract violation.
